youtube_description:
This is one of several Dora the Explorer VHS tapes I’ve watched in my childhood, and I’d love to record the full VHS of that to DVD. Anyways, here's the opening to the 2004 VHS of "Dora the Explorer: Super Silly Fiesta!", and in order as follows: 

1. Nick Jr. Baby's Curious Buddies preview [“Coming Soon” version]
2. Blue's Clues: Blue Talks preview 
3. Dora the Explorer: Dora's Pirate Adventure preview
4. Oswald VHS & DVD preview [“Available Now” version]
5. Peanuts Collection VHS & DVD preview [pretty neat how an ad for Peanuts titles appeared here; same with the 2002 VHS of “Dora’s Backpack Adventure” and the 1999 VHSs of “Blue’s Clues: ABC’s and 123’s” and “Blue’s Clues: Rhythm and Blue”]
6. "Feature Presentation"/Warning screen [1995 Viacom revision] 
7. 2002 Paramount Pictures logo 
8. Nick Jr. bumper - "Frogs" 

©2004 Viacom International, Inc. 
©2004 Paramount Pictures.
